issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: the Kenninghall Road plans, and a new bakery
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-the-kenninghall-road-plans-and-a-new-bakery

Morning, all. A full one this week. The planning committee meets on Tuesday 20 October to decide on the Kenninghall Road scheme, and judging by my inbox, a lot of you have opinions.

THIS WEEK

Kenninghall Road: what's being decided on Tuesday
The application is for 64 flats on the old builders' merchants site, eight storeys at the tallest point, with 22 of the flats offered at social rent. The officers' report recommends approval. Objections, 211 of them, mostly concern height and the loss of the yard used by the Saturday car boot. The meeting is open to the public from 7pm at the town hall and is streamed online.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/kenninghall-road-what-s-being-decided-on-tuesday

Fennick's Bakery opens on Chatsworth Road
The bakery that ran a stall at the Sunday market for three years has taken the old phone repair shop at number 92. Open from 7am Wednesday to Sunday. The cardamom buns sold out by 10 on the first day.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/fennick-s-bakery-opens-on-chatsworth-road

Millfields Park: the path is finally being fixed
Work on the flooded path by the river crossing starts on Monday 26 October and should take three weeks. The east gate will be closed during that time.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/millfields-park-the-path-is-finally-being-fixed

Clapton Pond clean-up
Volunteers are meeting at 10am on Sunday 25 October to clear leaves and litter from the pond. Gloves and bags provided. About two hours.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/clapton-pond-clean-up

DIARY

- Sat 17 Oct, 11am to 4pm: Apple Day at the Round Chapel community garden, free
- Tue 20 Oct, 7pm: planning committee, Kenninghall Road decision
- Thu 22 Oct, 7.30pm: quiz night at The Elderfield, teams of up to six
- Sun 25 Oct, 10am: Clapton Pond clean-up

That's your lot. See you next Friday.

Joe

--

issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: road closures and a new library opening time
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-road-closures-and-a-new-library-opening-time

Morning, all. Roadworks dominate this week, I'm afraid, but there's good news from the library.

THIS WEEK

Lea Bridge Road closures from Monday
Water main works close the westbound lane between the roundabout and Chatsworth Road for four weeks. Buses are diverted; the 55 and 56 will skip two stops. Expect queues at rush hour.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/lea-bridge-road-closures-from-monday

Library opens on Sundays again
From this weekend, the library on Northwold Road opens 11am to 3pm on Sundays, a year after Sunday hours were cut. A petition with 1,400 signatures helped.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/library-opens-on-sundays-again

New crossing on Lower Clapton Road
The zebra crossing parents have asked for near the primary school will be built in the half-term holiday. The council says it should be in use by the start of November.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/new-crossing-on-lower-clapton-road

Lost: a grey cat called Pudding
Last seen near Rushmore Road on Tuesday. Wearing a blue collar. If you've seen her, reply and I'll pass it on.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/lost-a-grey-cat-called-pudding

DIARY

- Sat, 10am to 2pm: Chatsworth Road market, with a knife sharpener this week
- Sun, 2pm: guided walk along the River Lea, meet at the Princess of Wales
- Wed, 7pm: residents' association meeting, St James's church hall

Mind the roadworks. See you next week.

Joe

--

issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: the marshes in summer, and a pub changes hands
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-the-marshes-in-summer-and-a-pub-changes-hands

Morning, all. It's been a hot week and the marshes have been packed. Some news about a pub you'll have opinions on.

THIS WEEK

The Anchor and Hope has new owners
The pub on the corner of Glyn Road has been bought by the people who run a wine bar in Hackney Wick. They say the pool table stays and the Sunday roast stays. They have not said anything about the prices.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/the-anchor-and-hope-has-new-owners

Hackney Marshes: the changing rooms reopen
After two years of repairs, the pavilion changing rooms reopen next weekend in time for the autumn league season. Showers are hot, we're told.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/hackney-marshes-the-changing-rooms-reopen

A new bike hangar on Mayola Road
Six spaces, £42 a year. The waiting list for the street is already 19 names long.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/a-new-bike-hangar-on-mayola-road

Swifts over the reservoir
A reader counted 80 swifts over the reservoirs on Wednesday evening. They'll be gone south within a fortnight.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/swifts-over-the-reservoir

DIARY

- Sat, 7pm: outdoor film on Mabley Green, bring a blanket
- Sun, all day: Springfield Park summer fair
- Thu, 6pm: free bike repair session outside the library

Stay cool. See you next Friday.

Joe

--

issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: the car boot's last Saturday?
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-the-car-boot-s-last-saturday

Morning, all. The car boot sale might be moving, the bins are changing, and there's a new place for coffee near the station.

THIS WEEK

Car boot sale may have to move
If the Kenninghall Road flats are approved, the Saturday car boot will lose its yard by next spring. The organisers have asked the council about using the school playground on Saturdays instead.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/car-boot-sale-may-have-to-move

Food waste collections move to Tuesdays
From the first week of next month, food waste in E5 will be collected on Tuesdays, not Thursdays. New stickers for your caddy are coming in the post.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/food-waste-collections-move-to-tuesdays

Coffee at the station
A kiosk has opened outside Clapton station, run by two brothers who used to have a van at the marshes. Oat milk at no extra charge.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/coffee-at-the-station

A mural for Chatsworth Road
Pupils from two local primary schools are designing a mural for the side of the launderette. Voting on the designs opens next week.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/a-mural-for-chatsworth-road

DIARY

- Sat, 8am: car boot sale, Kenninghall Road yard
- Mon, 7pm: talk on the history of the Lea navigation, library
- Thu, 7.30pm: quiz night at The Elderfield

See you next week.

Joe

--

issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: a tree on the high road, and the river's water quality
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-a-tree-on-the-high-road-and-the-river-s-water

Morning, all. Last weekend's storm took down a plane tree, and the river test results are in.

THIS WEEK

The plane tree outside the post office
The tree that fell on Saturday night was one of the oldest on the high road, planted around 1900. Nobody was hurt. The council says it will be replaced, but not with a plane, which has already started an argument.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/the-plane-tree-outside-the-post-office

River Lea water tests
Volunteer testers found E. coli levels near the marshes well above the bathing standard after heavy rain, and close to it in dry weeks. Don't swim, and keep dogs out after a downpour.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/river-lea-water-tests

The launderette's new hours
Open until 10pm on weekdays from now on, and the owner has added two large dryers.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/the-launderette-s-new-hours

Allotment plots available
The allotment society on Spring Hill has four half-plots free, a rare thing. The waiting list opens on Monday at 9am.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/allotment-plots-available

DIARY

- Sat, 10am: tree planting volunteers wanted, Millfields Park
- Sun, 11am: jumble sale, St James's church hall
- Tue, 6.30pm: allotment society open evening

See you next Friday.

Joe

--

issues.subject: E5 Dispatch: welcome to the new readers
issues.text:
E5 DISPATCH
Clapton and around. Friday {date}

View in your browser: https://e5dispatch.example/issues/e5-dispatch-welcome-to-the-new-readers

Morning, all. A warm welcome to the 300 or so of you who've signed up this month, many after moving to the area. Here's what's going on.

THIS WEEK

New to E5? Five things to know
The Sunday market on Chatsworth Road is better than the Saturday one. The marshes flood in winter. The 55 is quicker than the Overground into town after 9am. The library lends tools. And everyone has a view on the Kenninghall Road plans.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/new-to-e5-five-things-to-know

Summer reading at the library
The children's summer reading challenge starts this week. Six books over the holidays, a medal at the end.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/summer-reading-at-the-library

A new Turkish grill on Lower Clapton Road
In the old bookmaker's. The lamb is excellent and the queue on Friday nights is long.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/a-new-turkish-grill-on-lower-clapton-road

Parking zone consultation
The council is asking residents north of the pond about extending controlled parking to weekends. Closes at the end of the month.

Full story: https://e5dispatch.example/story/parking-zone-consultation

DIARY

- Sat, 9am: parkrun on the marshes
- Sun, 12pm: street party on Rushmore Road, all welcome
- Wed, 7pm: new residents' drinks at The Elderfield

Glad to have you. See you next Friday.

Joe

--
